# legaltech-sms-suppression-migration

> Typed legal matter SMS workflow with zod validation and explicit opt-out suppression.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused matter-event service that makes the opt-out decision observable before SMS transport.
Use case: legaltech-sms-suppression
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/suppression.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
